verdict.rationale: Bitbucket documents AI-powered features (AI code reviewer, Rovo access in terminal/IDE, AI-triggered pipeline automation for tasks like flaky test fixes and release notes) that function as delegable AI assistant capabilities, but these are narrow, task-specific integrations rather than a general-purpose built-in assistant users can delegate arbitrary tasks to. missing for 10: evidence of a unified in-product chat/agent interface for open-ended task delegation, independent hands-on validation of Rovo or the AI reviewer actually completing delegated tasks, and clarity on how deeply integrated vs. bolt-on these AI features are.
